subject: Quick thought on Austin Artistic Dental's online booking
body: Hi Dr. Hulse and team, I came across Austin Artistic Dental while researching local practices that focus on conservative, natural-looking veneers in the Austin area. I really appreciate your philosophy of avoiding bulky aesthetics and making patients feel genuinely comfortable. While browsing your current site, I noticed that the virtual consultation process and mobile booking flow could be streamlined to capture patients right away. To show you what I mean, I put together a modern, live prototype for your practice. It features a sticky mobile booking bar, an interactive services bento grid, and immediate Google review highlights right in the hero section. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x865b4cd39f7a07b7-0x66111cd2e71b146-gz75jcnks.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a sticky mobile call and booking bar at the bottom of the viewport
Highlighted direct patient review ratings immediately in the hero section
